questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The composition of water gas is
questions.solution:
Water gas is primarily composed of carbon
monoxide and hydrogen gas i.e. $\mathrm{CO}(g)+\mathrm{H}_2(g)$. It is a valuable industrial feedstock and used in production of chemicals, fuels and as a reducing agent in metallurgical applications.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which of the following hydrides is electron deficient?
questions.solution: Among the given hydrides $\mathrm{B}_2 \mathrm{H}_6$ is electron deficient because it has 8 covalent bonds and 12 electrons but it requires a total 14 electrons to form bonding. It lacks 2 electron pairs.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT true regarding the usage of hydrogen as a fuel?
options: Hydrogen gas can be easily liquefied and stored.

The combustible energy of hydrogen can be directly converted to electrical energy in a fuel
cell.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
\( $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{2}$\) can act as both oxidizing as well as reducing agent in both acidic and basic media.
Oxidizing action:
In acidic media,
\( 2 $\mathrm{~F}$e^{2+}+2 \mathrmH^{+}+$\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{2} \rightarrow$2 $\mathrm{~F}$e^{3+}+2 $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}$\)
In basic media, \( 2 $\mathrm{~F}$e^{2+}+$\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{2} \rightarrow$2 $\mathrm{~F}$e^{3+}+2 $\mathrm{OH}^{-}$\)
Reducing action:
In acidic media,
\( $\mathrm{HOCl}+\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{2} \rightarrow \mathrm{H}_{3} \mathrmO^{+}+\mathrm{Cl}^{-}+\mathrm{O}_{2}$\)
In basic media,
\( $\mathrm{I}_{2}+\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{2}+$2 $\mathrm{OH}^{-} \rightarrow$2 \mathrmI^{-}+2 $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}+\mathrm{O}_{2}$\)

questions.q: Water softening by Clark's process uses
questions.solution:

bicarbonates are converted into insoluble calcium and magnesium carbonates which are filtered off.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Hydrogen gas is not liberated when the following metal is added to dil $\mathrm{HCl}$
questions.solution:
The metals, present below hydrogen in the electrochemical series, cannot liberate hydrogen from the dilute acids.
Among the given metals only $\mathrm{Ag}$ is present below hydrogen in electrochemical series, so it does not evolve hydrogen with dil HCl. $\mathrm{Ag}+\text{ dil } \mathrm{HCl} \longrightarrow $$\text{ No reaction }$
